nodes.label: Nexus Universal API Gateway
nodes.rationale: Single reusable API route avoids creating a separate API route per module; dynamic module routing through one endpoint with auto authentication and consistent response format.

nodes.label: nexus() Builder
nodes.rationale: Fluent builder pattern for composing complex query endpoints in a type-safe way.

nodes.label: Satu Pintu APIProvider Rule
nodes.rationale: All data fetching must go through APIProvider(session).Endpoint().Data().Result() server-side or useFetcherData({endpoint:'/api/nexus'}) client-side, enforcing a single gateway, no axios, and database logic in app/nexus/modules/ rather than routes.

nodes.label: Direct fetch() to Kinau Backend Violation
nodes.rationale: 4 files call fetch(API_URL) directly bypassing the gateway and must be migrated to useFetcherData / API modules.
nodes.norm_label: direct fetch() to kinau backend violation

nodes.label: nexus() Builder in Components Warning
nodes.rationale: 36 existing files use nexus() builder; allowed to remain but new code should use useFetcherData with /api/nexus query string. Refactor incrementally when files are touched.

nodes.label: Deprecated Infra Files
nodes.rationale: 9 legacy/deprecated fetcher files (swr-loader, client.ts, api-client, callApi, duplicate nexus-client) must not receive new imports.
